sources.role: Official directory distinguishing Enterprise/Professional, Build Tools and C++ Runtime 2026 agreements
sources.finding: Use the actual 2026 terms, not an assumed 2022 agreement or the 190-byte installed REDIST forwarding stub.

sources.section: Distributable Code Files for Visual Studio 2026 and later; Visual C++ Runtime Files
sources.quote: If you have a validly licensed copy of such software, you may copy and distribute with your program the unmodified form of the files listed below, subject to the License Terms for the software.
sources.finding: The list identifies VC145/redist files and excludes debug_nonredist/preview components. A filename list is not unconditional permission and does not itself establish static-CRT source/object licensing coverage.

Full-use and trial rights differ; trial-built production distribution is not permitted by the trial clause. Section 7 distribution is conditional, requires significant functionality and protective terms, and contains an Excluded License restriction. A hosted Enterprise installation path does not alone prove the applicable full-use entitlement.

The separate open-source-dependency build permission in 1(d) has prerequisites and 1(e) restricts development/testing modifications without a Visual Studio Product license. It must not be presented as an unconditional redistribution grant or proof of arbitrary LGPL-modification rights with that compiler.

sources.quote: You may install and use any number of copies of the software.
sources.finding: Installation/use permission is not permission to redistribute. Section 4 separately restricts sharing/distribution. Do not substitute this end-user runtime agreement for the applicable developer distribution rights.
